subject.title: fix: keep command cron jobs operator-scoped [AI]

question: Does the operator-only invariant intentionally cover every on-exit job, and is the agent-runtime creation path already incapable of submitting command or on-exit shapes?
rationale: The patch correctly protects existing-job operations, but this is a host-command authorization boundary and the protected maintainer label requires an owner to confirm the complete intended contract.

options.title: Approve the boundary
options.body: Confirm that the agent cron tool cannot create command or on-exit jobs and that all on-exit jobs are operator-owned, then land this patch.

options.title: Add creation rejection
options.body: If those shapes can reach cron.add under an internal agent-runtime identity, reject them there and add focused proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that the agent cron tool cannot create command or on-exit jobs and that all on-exit jobs are operator-owned, then land this patch.
